items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Like we'd walk in the studio with Miles... we'd all walk in the studio

ctx.x: Like we'd walk in the studio with Miles, and we'd have Miles, J.J. and Monk and Milt and we'd all walk in the studio and then Miles would say, 'What are we going to play?' And then right away something would come up in my stomach. It was such a thrill, you know. I said no-one knows what we're going to play. Now, what's going to happen?
